evals.prompt: Make models selectable on a canvas embedded inside a resized dashboard panel, with hover feedback and touch support.
evals.expected_output: A canvas-rect-relative Raycaster approach with explicit pickables, normalized pointer coordinates, stable hover state, and listener cleanup.
assertions: Normalizes pointer coordinates against getBoundingClientRect rather than the window
Limits raycasting to semantic selectable targets
Covers touch/pointer lifecycle and hover clearing

evals.prompt: The delete action is only available by clicking a 3D mesh; make it usable with keyboard and screen readers.
evals.expected_output: Routes semantic command accessibility to web-accessibility while retaining optional 3D interaction.
assertions: Names web-accessibility as the primary accessibility owner
Does not present raycasting as the sole accessible activation mechanism
